WITH operator_rates AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    SUM(scancount) AS total_scans,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  WHERE scancount IS NOT NULL
     OR (gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0)
  GROUP BY crewref
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM operator_rates
  WHERE avg_gb_per_minute > (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) FROM operator_rates)
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_scans) AS avg_total_scans,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute - (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) FROM operator_rates)) AS avg_margin_above_all_operator_average
FROM qualified;

assumptions.assumption: The per-operator rate is the average of each scan record's GB-per-minute ratio, excluding rows missing either input or with zero duration; NULL scan counts are ignored by SUM.
